framework.order: 1) residual dimension on the method floor (does the method keep its own floor); 2) floor repair: per row a single vertical shift of the floor (self floor) and a refit on it; 3) every load dimension on the repaired floor

residual.primary: method floor (v1.1 floor_eval: method floor plus the per-clip correction)

loads.method_floor: computed as well, descriptive (user decision 2026-11-08 11:51-11:56: all loads under both floors)

floor_repair.kind: per-clip constant shift of the floor, motion unchanged (user decision: clip shift, no per-frame repair)
floor_repair.estimator: utils/motiogen/evalkit/floor.py self_floor_shift (moved unchanged from python/scripts/evalkit_batch.py): median over the scored frames of the lowest sole-landmark elevation (heel / toe, both sides) among the landmarks whose vertical speed is below 0.05 m/s; fallback when no landmark is still: median lowest elevation
floor_repair.applied_to: the floor the method-floor row was evaluated on (floor_eval_m); the shifted row is refitted on floor_eval_m + shift with no per-clip correction
floor_repair.known_bias: checked on known-floor data before use (scratch/self_floor_estimators.py): synthetic walk -0.6 cm, other synthetic -0.3 cm, CLoSD -0.2 cm, PRIMAL +0.1 cm

forced.definition: forced metrics (强测算, user decision 2026-11-08 11:56) also count the frames whose only failure is an unbalanced external force (the floor repair did not remove the residual); reported in separate forced_* fields with the residual size, never mixed into the primary metrics
forced.lumbar: primary: reachable frames (E3 type 2 excluded). forced: finite frames that are neither type-2 internal (|lumbar reserve| > 1 N m) nor type-2 kinematic (within 0.5 deg of a lumbar coordinate limit), i.e. reachable plus type-2-external-only frames; forced_residual_bw_p95 over the forced external frames; type-1 rows (IK median RMS > 3 cm, pelvis coordinate at its limit, joint reactions invalid) get no forced metric
forced.leg_muscle: primary: muscle effort mean over the scored static-optimization frames whose nearest residual frame is residual-negative (residual.judge); forced: over every scored frame (the v1.1 definition, key muscle_effort_sum_a2_mean kept, also written as forced_muscle_effort_sum_a2_mean) with the residual-positive share of those frames
forced.ergo: no forced variant: REBA / RULA do not use the ground reactions (the legs-support term uses contact), so they have no residual-only failure
forced.excluded_from_forced: type-1 rows, type-2 internal and kinematic frames (user decision: forced covers only the unbalanced external force); rows whose solver failed stay failed (no retry)

validation.split: heldout3, subject seeds 401 and 402 (config/evalkit_synth_20261107.json splits.heldout3), same generator, bases, defects and sizes as heldout2; built only after this file and the implementing code are committed; run once; no field of this file changes after the run
validation.runs: 1) truth; 2) tool on the method floor (v1.1 pipeline, the per-clip correction with the split's own offset reference); 3) self-floor tool per clip from the frames of 2), dims residual + ergo on every clip, + muscle + upper (lumbar) on the control, float_whole_m and penetrate_whole_m clips; 4) lumbar with the truth ground reactions (truth mode) on every control clip
validation.targets: whole-clip floor defects (float_whole_m, penetrate_whole_m) only move the pelvis of the control motion of the same base and subject, so after the repair they are scored against that control's truth (ergo classes, muscle effort, truth-GRF lumbar); every other clip against its own truth

ergo.clips: the v1.1 ergo pass clips (every clip except bone_stretch, slide and, under the method floor, float_whole) plus float_whole_m against its control's truth
ergo.pass: v1.1 line: false-kill and missed-kill <= 5% with the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound <= 10%, REBA and RULA separately

muscle.criterion: descriptive (v1.1 muscle.criterion, user decision 2026-11-07 16:25): median relative and absolute error, Spearman, primary and forced each against the control truth effort over the same frames

lumbar.clips: control, float_whole_m, penetrate_whole_m whose self-floor run and the control's truth-GRF run are both measured
lumbar.metric: L5_S1_compression_p95_bw (primary, reachable frames) against the control's truth-GRF value
lumbar.pass: Spearman >= 0.8 and median |relative error| <= 0.15 (the V2 line of config/evalkit_upper_muscle_20261108.json; 约定，未经推演)
lumbar.reported: mean metric, forced metrics, reachable-frame counts; if the line fails the lumbar dimension on the self floor is reported as ground-reaction sensitive, descriptive only

validation.floor_estimate: descriptive: repaired floor minus true floor per defect and size (true floor of a whole-clip defect = input floor + signed size)
validation.replication: the v1.1 score of the method-floor run on heldout3 is reported as a replication; v1.1 stays validated on heldout2
validation.on_failure: a failed line is reported as failed; the dimension on the self floor is then not validated and is reported descriptively until the user decides

smoke.check: merged view per row: residual from the method-floor row, loads from the self-floor row (primary) with the method-floor loads (method_floor_*) and the forced metrics alongside
